long_biography.plain_text:
Vamvakas developed his business career in Greek commercial shipping. As chairman of AB Maritime, he oversees a company active in worldwide vessel management and the carriage of bulk cargoes. The platform has operated for decades from the Athens area, managing geared bulk carriers in the handysize and supramax range and coordinating technical, crewing, maintenance and regulatory functions.

His role has been operational rather than passive, extending across company systems, fleet acquisitions and sector engagement. AB Maritime has added second-hand bulk carriers, maintained a seven-vessel fleet and participated in maritime quality and environmental programmes. Vamvakas has also held responsibilities in industry organisations, reinforcing a career centred on ship management, fleet renewal and dry-bulk transport.
